title: Eswatini VAT Notes
content:
Eswatini VAT (SZL)

  • Standard VAT rate: 15% (Value Added Tax Act).
  • Currency: Lilangeni (SZL), symbol E.
  • Zero-rated / exempt supplies follow Eswatini Revenue Service (ERS) guidance; confirm before invoicing.
  • Certification, metrology calibration, training, and standards sales may have distinct tax treatments; Finance reviews before posting.
